Constraints: the slot must lie entirely within working hours 09:00-17:00 UTC, must start on a 30-minute boundary, and every team member must be free for the full hour. local users = tool('list_users', {})
local user_ids = {}
for _, u in ipairs(users) do
  user_ids[#user_ids + 1] = u.id
end

local dates = {'2026-06-15', '2026-06-16', '2026-06-17', '2026-06-18', '2026-06-19'}

-- Collect busy intervals per user per date
local busy_by_user_date = {}
for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
  busy_by_user_date[uid] = {}
  for _, date in ipairs(dates) do
    local avail = tool('get_availability', {user_id = uid, date = date})
    busy_by_user_date[uid][date] = avail.busy or {}
  end
end

-- Helper: parse HH:MM to minutes since midnight
local function to_minutes(t)
  local h, m = t:match('^(%d+):(%d+)$')
  return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

local function overlaps(start_m, end_m, busy_start, busy_end)
  local bs = to_minutes(busy_start)
  local be = to_minutes(busy_end)
  return start_m < be and end_m > bs
end

-- Candidate starts: 09:00, 09:30, ..., 16:00 (so end <= 17:00)
local candidates = {}
for m = 9*60, 16*60, 30 do
  candidates[#candidates + 1] = m
end

local function format_ts(date, minutes)
  local h = math.floor(minutes / 60)
  local m = minutes % 60
  return string.format('%sT%02d:%02d:00Z', date, h, m)
end

-- Find earliest slot
for _, date in ipairs(dates) do
  for _, start_m in ipairs(candidates) do
    local end_m = start_m + 60
    local all_free = true
    for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
      local busy_list = busy_by_user_date[uid][date]
      for _, b in ipairs(busy_list) do
        if overlaps(start_m, end_m, b.start, b['end']) then
          all_free = false
          break
        end
      end
      if not all_free then break end
    end
    if all_free then
      return {
        start = format_ts(date, start_m),
        ['end'] = format_ts(date, end_m),
        users = user_ids,
        n_users = #user_ids
      }
    end
  end
end

return {error = 'no slot found', users = user_ids}
